en.title: Compare funding on the same clock
en.summary: Start a cross-venue funding study with settlement timestamps and a common holding window. A quoted rate may use a different time basis than the payment itself. Reconstruct cash flows over the same window before ranking spreads, then include fees and slippage.
en.risk: An apparent spread can disappear when settlement times differ or the available size cannot be filled at the assumed price.

zh.title: 比较资金费率，先对齐结算窗口
zh.summary: 做跨市场资金费率研究时，先确认结算时点和持有窗口。报价采用的时间口径可能和实际支付周期不同。用同一窗口重算现金流，再计入手续费和滑点，看差异还在不在。
zh.risk: 结算时点不同，或实际成交量和价格达不到假设时，表面的费率差可能消失。

en.title: Validate robot data at episode boundaries
en.summary: Use an episode as the unit for your first dataset quality check. On a small sample, resolve video, state, and action ranges through the metadata. Inspect timestamps and alignment before paying the cost of a full dataset pass.
en.risk: A sample can miss corruption that only appears across files, cameras, or recording sessions. Expand coverage once the checks pass.

zh.title: 从 episode 边界开始检查机器人数据
zh.summary: 先抽一小批 episode 做质检。通过元数据定位每段视频、状态和动作的范围，检查时间戳和对齐情况，再决定如何做全量扫描。
zh.risk: 小样本可能漏掉只在跨文件、跨相机或跨采集批次时出现的问题。初步检查通过后，再扩大覆盖范围。
